utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on the repair drive—what’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re keeping it pretty simple—mostly little fixes like patching the fence and that wobbly step. If you want to help, I can set you up with gloves and tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds good — I can help with the little fixes. Just let me know when to come by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Rosa—I'll keep an eye out for those screwdrivers and extension cords and let you know if I spot any.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess—that would be a big help. I’ll send around the updated details for Sunday at the community center so everyone knows where to bring things.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds perfect, Rosa—I’ll keep an eye out and pass along anything useful I find.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring a small broken thing on Saturday morning to the community hall. Thanks for sorting it out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks—I'll note that down. If you hear of anything else gathered, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do. I’ll let you know if I come across anything else.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the pickup time and the first load, so I can line up my route properly. Once Jules confirms that, I’ll be able to plan it out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, I’m still waiting on the pickup time and first load details too, but I’ll share them as soon as I get them. Then you can line up your route.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’ll hold off on routing until you have those details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still in, and I can bring the wrench set if you need it. Just let me know what time we’re heading out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Dane — it’s Sunday now at the community center, not Saturday on the porch. I’m bringing the lamp by later today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—thanks for the update. I’ll head to the community center later today and bring the wrench set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds like a good fit for me—what time should I come by after pickup?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit foggy, but Saturday morning by the community hall should work—maybe after pickup, whenever that is for you. I’ll bring something small that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning by the community hall works for me—I can come after pickup. I’ll have to head out before dinner, but I should be able to help for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be at the repair drive table by the community center at 4 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll swing by if I can and see what still needs doing. Point me to the table if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Bo. I’ll be at the table by the community center at 4, and I’ll point you there if I see you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—just to confirm, what kind of repair drive is it, and what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and pass along any repair requests I hear. If you hear of anything specific that needs fixing, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira—I'll do that. If I hear any specific repair requests, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s happening this Saturday morning by the community hall, and Hana’s organizing it. If you’ve got any broken small items, bring them along and I’ll help sort them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll bring a couple small things to fix. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Come by around 9 a.m. at the community hall — I’ll be there sorting things out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can send it over right now. Let me know if there’s anything else I should look for.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Rey — that’s perfect. I’ll spread it around as soon as it lands so we can keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—happy to help. If anything else comes up for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and see who can help out. Then we can sort out what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. We’ll sort the repairs on Saturday morning at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word and I’ll ask around for a few more helpers before Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive—right, I’ve heard a bit about it. What’s the plan for it?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is really happening, right? And Hana’s the one organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds right to me — I think it’s happening, and Hana’s the one putting it together. I may have missed a detail or two, though.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep track of what we still need for the repair drive—just let me know what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve heard some tools and basic supplies have come in, but I’m not sure of the full list yet. Do you want me to help check for anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes—could you check on tools, screws, tape, and any spare parts? I’ll keep the list updated as we hear more.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, I can help spread the word and link anyone who wants to pitch in with Hana and Opal.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help out with the repair drive—just point me to what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Bo — I’ll connect you with Hana and Opal so they can tell you what’s needed. Thanks for pitching in!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I may stop by with something small on Saturday morning by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — just to note, the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday. If it’s small, bring it by then and I’ll be there to take it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center works better for me. I’ll bring something small then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: What time does the repair drive start? I can stop by after school pickup, but I’ll need to head out before dinner.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Faye — send the list over and I’ll share it with everyone right away. We’ll keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll send the list over shortly. Let me know the start time when you can so I can plan around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the pickup time and the first items before I can plan my route properly. Do we know what they need most at the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet—let’s confirm the pickup time and ask what items they need most first. Then I can help sort the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds best—I’d like the pickup time first, then we can sort the list and I can map out the route.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on the repair drive—what’s the plan so far?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep passing along any repair requests I hear while I’m out running errands, and thanks for helping spread the word. If you hear anyone who needs a hand, send them our way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anyone who needs help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m still a bit foggy, but I can bring something small that needs fixing on Saturday morning by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Actually, it moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the community hall. If you’ve got something small to fix, bring it then and I’ll keep an eye out for screwdrivers and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks for catching that — Sunday at the community center it is. I’ll bring something small that needs fixing and look for you then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday morning at the community hall works well—just bring them by then, and I’ll help sort what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll bring my gloves and anything small that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks—your gloves will help a lot. See you Saturday morning at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and tell folks to swing by if they can help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep track of who’s coming by and make sure everyone knows where to go.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive to folks so they know to come by if they can help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes—Saturday morning by the community hall still works. Bring your lamp along, and I’ll make sure it gets sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for Saturday morning at the community hall, right? And when should I have the drill and tools sorted by?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it’s still on for Saturday morning at the community hall. If you can have the drill and tools ready by then, that would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be at the repair drive table by the community center at 4 o’clock.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Eli — I’ll bring the gloves and tools, and we can get you set up at the table. See you at 4.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus — see you at 4 o’clock at the community center table.
